MIRRORS.title: Mirror du phong (cach nhau bang dau phay, theo thu tu uu tien)

metadata.author: MuseAi
metadata.description: Dien dan Tinhte (tinhte.vn) — doc thread cong nghe mien phi, khong can dang nhap. Chi doc: bam thread mo thang reader, khong dang bai/like/tra loi. KHONG co tim kiem tu khoa: XenForo bat cookie CSRF (xf_csrf) ma runtime vBook khong doc duoc (da thu 3 cach ngay 20/11 deu HTTP 400) — hay duyet bang Trang chu / The loai. Board dung /forums/<slug>.<id>/ (12 board that, lay tu /forums/), thread dung /thread/<slug>.<id>/, phan trang danh sach va bai trong thread dung /page-N. Trang thread la Next.js nen bai viet doc tu JSON __NEXT_DATA__ (job posts), khong phai .message XenForo.
